_readme: Edit badge names/descriptions freely — the server reads this at startup. wordTiers award by total words written (min). usage badges award ONCE the first time a committed story line matches: 'triggers' fires on ANY listed word/phrase; 'combos' fires when EVERY word of one listed combination appears in the same line, in any order. A badge may carry either or both (case-insensitive, whole words; a trailing ? or ! in a trigger is required literally). Unlocks announce in session chat and toast every connected player. Keep ids stable — they're stored on user accounts.

wordTiers.name: 🔫 There. Out Loud.
wordTiers.desc: Made an account. Said it — there, out loud.

wordTiers.name: 🫶 You can practice with me.
wordTiers.desc: Write 15,000 words. You can practice with me.

wordTiers.name: ☁️ I miss clouds I miss you
wordTiers.desc: Write 40,000 words. I miss clouds. I miss you.

wordTiers.name: 😤 It's not my fault you don't like girls!
wordTiers.desc: Write 75,000 words. It's not my fault!

wordTiers.name: 🌀 Crazy Together
wordTiers.desc: Write 150,000 words. If we're both going crazy, we'll go crazy together.

usage.name: 🐺 Omega Badge
usage.desc: Write “puppy” into a story line. Good boy.

usage.name: 🐓 Just the tip.
usage.desc: Write it into a story line. Just the tip, though.

usage.name: 😏 Smutty Buddy
usage.desc: Get a moan into the story.

usage.name: 🌀 If We're Both Going Crazy
usage.desc: Get “crazy” and “together” into the same story line.

usage.name: 💩 Resume it, Stupid
usage.desc: Try to write while the game is paused. Resume it, stupid.
